stories.title: U.S. companies from Nvidia to Apple face a growing China dilemma
stories.summary: The stakes have just gotten higher for businesses navigating the U.S. and China markets.
stories.zh_title: 從英偉達到蘋果等美國公司面臨日益嚴重的中國困境
stories.zh_summary: 對於開拓美國和中國市場的企業來說，風險變得越來越大。

stories.title: Nvidia warns chip buyers of legal risks tied to China AI access, sources tell CNBC
stories.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department is making moves to tighten export controls.
stories.zh_title: 消息人士告訴 CNBC，英偉達警告晶片買家注意與中國人工智慧接入相關的法律風險
stories.zh_summary: 美國商務部正在採取措施收緊出口管制。

stories.title: Here’s how much of Deutsche Bank’s market cap has been wiped away after reports on 15 million leaked documents
stories.summary: Deutsche Bank saw as much as €3.8 billion ($4.2 billion) of its market cap wiped away after a team of media organizations wrote about a trove of 15 million leaked documents.
stories.zh_title: 以下是 1500 萬份文件外洩的報告後，德意志銀行的市值縮水了多少
stories.zh_summary: 在一組媒體組織通報了 1,500 萬份外洩文件後，德意志銀行的市值蒸發了 38 億歐元（42 億美元）。

stories.title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
stories.summary: Three months since introducing its product, AI cybersecurity startup Corba has raised a $125 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation led by NEA.
stories.zh_title: 網路安全 AI 新創公司 Corma 在約 3 個月內達到 10 億美元的估值
stories.zh_summary: 自推出產品以來三個月，人工智慧網路安全新創公司 Corba 已在 NEA 的帶領下，以 10 億美元的估值籌集了 1.25 億美元的 A 輪融資。

stories.title: Google Maps can now create trip itineraries for you
stories.summary: Google is launching a new AI trip-planning feature for Maps that allows the app to create custom itineraries for you and provide real-time details about each stop. The update, which is rolling out to the Gemini-powered Ask Maps chatbot inside the app, lets you plan a one-day outing or a trip spanning several days. As […]
stories.zh_title: Google 地圖現在可以為您建立行程表
stories.zh_summary: Google 即將為「Google 地圖」推出一項全新的人工智慧行程規劃功能，讓該應用程式能夠為您建立自訂行程，並提供每個停靠點的即時資訊。這項更新正在應用程式內由 Gemini 提供支援的 Ask Maps 聊天機器人中推出，讓您能夠規劃一日遊或橫跨多日的旅程。

stories.title: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents
stories.summary: The California lawsuit represents one of the first attempts to hold an AI lab legally accountable for a rogue agent incident.
stories.zh_title: 加州州檢察長因惡意代理人事件起訴 OpenAI
stories.zh_summary: 加州這起訴訟案是首批試圖追究 AI 實驗室對惡意代理程式事件法律責任的案例之一。

stories.title: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: The industry will be ‘fine’
stories.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged the special role Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has played in the AI boom, but ultimately thinks the industry will be “fine” without him at the helm.
stories.zh_title: 山姆·奧特曼談論沒有黃仁勳的輝達：業界會「沒事」
stories.zh_summary: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 承認，Nvidia 執行長 Jensen Huang 在人工智慧的蓬勃發展中扮演了特殊角色，但最終他認為，即使沒有 Jensen Huang 掌舵，這個產業也會「沒問題」。

stories.title: Jim Cramer says Nvidia’s leadership shake-up won’t derail the AI trade
stories.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer pushed back against fears that Nvidia's leadership shake-up could unravel the AI boom.
stories.zh_title: 吉姆·克萊默 (Jim Cramer) 表示，輝達 (Nvidia) 的領導層變動不會影響人工智慧 (AI) 產業的發展。
stories.zh_summary: CNBC 的 Jim Cramer 反駁了人們對輝達 (Nvidia) 管理層大洗牌可能導致人工智慧 (AI) 發展受挫的擔憂。

stories.title: U.S. dollar’s AI-driven breakout could become a stock-market wrecking ball
stories.summary: The dollar recently climbed to its strongest level in a year and a half.
stories.zh_title: 美元受人工智慧驅動的突破性走勢可能成為股市的破壞性力量
stories.zh_summary: 美元近期升至一年半以來的最高點。

stories.title: Berkshire upped its bet on a beleaguered U.S. housing market, while souring on these bank stocks
stories.summary: Berkshire Hathaway stepped up its investments in the U.S. housing market last quarter, nearly doubling its stake in home builder Lennar.
stories.zh_title: 巴郡加碼押注陷入困境的美國房地產市場，同時對這些銀行股的態度轉趨負面。
stories.zh_summary: 巴菲特旗下波克夏·海瑟威公司 (Berkshire Hathaway) 上一季加大了對美國房地產市場的投資，將其在房屋建築商 Lennar 的持股幾乎翻了一倍。

stories.title: Big Nuclear isn’t worried about the Democrats stopping data centers
stories.summary: Constellation Energy - America's largest operator of nuclear power plants - does not share Wall Street's concerns that the Democrats will slow down data center development. On the company's third-quarter earnings call last week, CEO Joe Dominguez was, for lack of a better word, unbothered as he addressed the blue wave. "I do think we've […]
stories.zh_title: 大型核電業者並不擔心民主黨會阻止資料中心的發展
stories.zh_summary: Constellation Energy 是美國最大的核電廠營運商，該公司並不認同華爾街的擔憂，即民主黨將放緩資料中心的發展。在上週的第三季財報電話會議上，執行長 Joe Dominguez 在談到這個問題時，用一個比較貼切的詞來說，顯得相當淡定。

stories.title: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh stresses importance of AI to economy, but says it could ‘disappoint’
stories.zh_title: 聯準會主席凱文·沃什 (Kevin Warsh) 強調人工智慧對經濟的重要性，但表示人工智慧可能會「令人失望」。

stories.title: Jordan Belfort’s new AI voice startup, Tone, wants to sell like the ‘Wolf of Wall Street’
stories.summary: Belfort claims his AI sales voice can already close deals almost as well as the best human salespeople, and he thinks it will catch up in a year.
stories.zh_title: 喬丹·貝爾福特 (Jordan Belfort) 的新創 AI 語音公司 Tone 希望像「華爾街之狼」一樣大賣
stories.zh_summary: 貝爾福特聲稱，他的 AI 銷售語音已經能夠像最優秀的人類銷售人員一樣成交交易，他認為 AI 將在一年內趕上人類。

stories.title: Stanley Druckenmiller dumped these chip stocks while buying into SpaceX and Palantir
stories.summary: Druckenmiller’s family office unloaded AMD and Sandisk shares in the third quarter.
stories.zh_title: 史丹利·德魯肯米勒 (Stanley Druckenmiller) 出售這些晶片股，同時買入 SpaceX 和 Palantir 的股票。
stories.zh_summary: 德魯肯米勒的家族辦公室在第三季出脫了超微 (AMD) 和 SanDisk 的股票。
